name: Aegis
shortDescription: Credential isolation proxy for AI agents with encrypted vault and audit logging.

rawRecord.name: Aegis
rawRecord.short_description: Credential isolation proxy for AI agents with encrypted vault and audit logging.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Sits between AI agents and external APIs to handle credential injection at the network boundary. Features an AES-256-GCM encrypted vault, domain guard enforcement, per-agent identity and scoping, a declarative YAML policy engine, body inspection for credential leakage, RBAC with granular permissions, Shamir's Secret Sharing for team key management, and a full audit ledger. Includes a web dashboard and Prometheus metrics.
